sentences.text: 4 14-08-2024 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, informant and the State .
2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under section 420 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 138 of N I Act.
3 . At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that with the intervention of well-wishers, the matter between the parties has been amicably resolved and settled outside the Court.
5. Learned counsel for the State as well as informant do not controvert the contention made on behalf of petitioner.

6. Considering the fact that matter between the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.32154 of 2024(4)
dt.14-08-2024 parties has already been compromised and in the facts and circumstance of the case,
in the event of arrest or surrender within six weeks from today, let the petitioner, as named above,
